Config prints the configuration the pg store's commands run with, every
key resolved (a key the file leaves out has its default), as TOML, with
where it came from and its fingerprint (a hash of the values: search
--json reports it, and syncs, embeds and logged queries record it).

The file is --config FILE, else AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else
~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gomuxai/index.toml); with
no file there, the built-in defaults apply. A file named by --config or
the environment must exist, and an unknown key is an error. Print the
defaults into a file to start one: agent index config > index.toml. See
docs/INDEX-V2.md, "Configuration", for what each section tunes.

Usage:
  agent index config [flags]

Examples:
  agent index config
  agent index config --config tune/rrf30.toml --json

Flags:
      --config string   The index configuration (TOML; default: AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else ~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml, else built-in defaults)
  -h, --help            help for config
      --json            Print {"path", "fingerprint", "config"}

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
